lint.$comment: @nx/eslint/plugin infers this as `eslint:lint`, which `nx affected -t lint` does NOT match — so the gate and CI never linted this project. Declaring it explicitly is what puts it under the gate.

sync-docs.$comment: ng-packagr refuses assets from outside the package root, so the customer-facing docs are copied in before the build. The copies are gitignored — docs/ is the single source.

sync-generators.$comment: Compiles tools/satori-generators into the package so a CUSTOMER can run them: libs/platform/AGENTS.md told them to run `nx g ./tools/satori-generators:…`, a path only this repository has. Must precede the ng-packagr build, which clears its destination — writing into dist/ afterwards survives until the first cache hit. Also the only thing that typechecks the generators: the project has lint and no typecheck, and two real type errors were sitting in it.
